props.name: query
props.description: What to find. A string is split into words unless `splitWords` is false; an array is used term by term.

props.name: splitWords
props.description: Split a string query on whitespace so each word matches on its own, in any order.

props.name: wordStart
props.description: Only match at the start of a word — “an” finds “Anna” but not “Joanna”.
